                      </EntityCondition>
                    </ByEntityCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>

                      <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0" dynamicsDimension="time" />
                      <SpeedActionTarget>
                        <AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="0.0" />
                      </SpeedActionTarget>
                    </SpeedAction>
                  </LongitudinalAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="ReachedCurb" delay="0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition>
                      <StoryboardElementStateCondition storyboardElementType="action" storyboardElementRef="CrossRoad" state="endTransition" />
                    </ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
            <Event name="HoldMeasurement" priority="parallel">
              <Action name="Hold">
                <PrivateAction>
                  <LongitudinalAction>
                    <SpeedAction>
                      <SpeedActionDynamics dynamicsShape="step" value="0" dynamicsDimension="time" />
                      <SpeedActionTarget>
                        <AbsoluteTargetSpeed value="0.0" />
                      </SpeedActionTarget>
                    </SpeedAction>
                  </LongitudinalAction>
                </PrivateAction>
              </Action>
              <StartTrigger>
                <ConditionGroup>
                  <Condition name="HoldUntilEnd" delay="0" conditionEdge="rising">
                    <ByValueCondition>
                      <SimulationTimeCondition value="13.0" rule="greaterThan" />
                    </ByValueCondition>
                  </Condition>
                </ConditionGroup>
              </StartTrigger>
            </Event>
          </Maneuver>
        </ManeuverGroup>
        <StartTrigger>
          <ConditionGroup>
            <Condition name="Start" delay="0" conditionEdge="rising">
              <ByValueCondition>
                <SimulationTimeCondition value="0.0" rule="greaterThan" />
              </ByValueCondition>
            </Condition>
          </ConditionGroup>
        </StartTrigger>
        <StopTrigger>
          <ConditionGroup>
            <Condition name="End" delay="0" conditionEdge="rising">
              <ByValueCondition>
                <SimulationTimeCondition value="12.0" rule="greaterThan" />
              </ByValueCondition>
            </Condition>
          </ConditionGroup>
          <ConditionGroup>
            <Condition name="MeasurementComplete" delay="0" conditionEdge="rising">
              <ByValueCondition>
                <ParameterCondition parameterRef="vs_done" value="1" rule="equalTo" />
              </ByValueCondition>
            </Condition>
          </ConditionGroup>
        </StopTrigger>
      </Act>
    </Story>
    <StopTrigger>
      <ConditionGroup>
        <Condition name="criteria_CollisionTest" delay="0" conditionEdge="rising">
          <ByValueCondition>
            <ParameterCondition parameterRef="" value="" rule="lessThan" />
          </ByValueCondition>
        </Condition>
      </ConditionGroup>
    </StopTrigger>
  </Storyboard>
</OpenSCENARIO>
